title: Supplier compliance attestation without causal attribution
operational_setting: A buyer accepts a supplier only if required compliance evidence is verified; the buyer does not need to know what caused the supplier to become compliant.
trust_boundary: Buyer relies on evidence from supplier and independent verifier.
intended_transition: Supplier becomes accepted as meeting specified requirements.

attack.procedure: Complete onboarding and settlement without representing who or what caused compliance, and test whether any operational requirement fails.

success_criteria_for_attack: If the process remains complete, causal attribution is downstream/conditional rather than part of the operational kernel.

verdict.rationale: Tests whether attribution can be safely excluded from the core.
